meta.titolo: {sito} · The right gift, picked for you
meta.descrizione: Tell me who you're buying for: I'll suggest 4 concrete gift ideas within your budget, with links to find them online.

home.occhiello: The right gift, in a few swipes
home.titolo: Tell me who they are. I’ll handle the gift.
home.sottotitolo: Describe them in a couple of lines, answer a few questions by swiping cards and discover tailored gifts: keep the ones you like with a ♥ and find them online.

uno.testo: Who they are to you, the occasion and your budget. Takes seconds.

due.testo: Curious, precise questions: right for yes, left for no.

tre.testo: Swipe through ideas, save the ones you ♥ and find them on Amazon or Google Shopping.

paese.aiuto: Prices in {valuta} and shops from this country.

budget.etichetta: How much do you want to spend?
budget.aiuto: If you only enter one number, I’ll treat it as the maximum.

descrizione.etichetta: What are they like? What do they love, what don’t they, what’s their personality
descrizione.segnaposto: E.g. Loves cooking and Nordic crime novels, hates clutter, quite reserved but very witty…

haGia.etichetta: What do they already have, or have recently received?
haGia.segnaposto: E.g. Just bought a coffee machine.

filtri.aiuto: Optional: if you don’t pick anything, everything is fine.

modulo.avvisoPrivacy: Don’t write names, surnames or details that could identify the person: I don’t need them to find the gift.

errori.relazione: Choose who they are to you.
errori.budget: Enter how much you want to spend.
errori.budgetOrdine: The minimum can’t be higher than the maximum.

soprannome.aiuto: Only used for the questions on your device: it is never sent or stored.

esempio.pulsante: Not sure where to start? Try an example

caricamento.domandeNota: Answer by swiping: it takes a minute and the ideas will be spot on.

privacy.bozza: Draft to be reviewed by a legal advisor before publication.
privacy.intro: This page explains what data {sito} processes, why and for how long. In short: we don’t ask who you are, we don’t ask who you’re buying for and we don’t use tracking cookies.

titolare.testo: The data controller is {titolare}. For any privacy request you can write to {email}.

punti.1: The information you enter in the form: relationship, occasion, budget, delivery country, age and the optional descriptions (tastes, what they already have, what they can’t stand). We never ask for the name or surname of the person you’re buying for, nor for your details: in fact, we ask you not to enter them.
punti.2: Before storing the texts and sending them to the artificial intelligence service, we automatically remove any email addresses and phone numbers.
punti.3: The ideas suggested, your 👍/👎 and clicks on the search links, without linking them to your identity.
punti.4: Your IP address, only to limit abuse: we immediately turn it into a non-reversible code (hash), we don’t link it to your requests and we delete it within 48 hours.
punti.5: We don’t create accounts and we don’t use visitor analytics tools.

punti.1: To suggest the ideas you ask for: it’s the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
punti.2: To improve the quality of the ideas, by analysing requests, answers and feedback anonymously (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
punti.3: To protect the service from abuse and excessive costs (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

fornitori.testo: We rely on providers that process data on our behalf, as processors: Anthropic (generates the ideas with the Claude model: the form texts are sent to its servers), Supabase (database) and Vercel (hosts the site). Some providers may process data outside the European Union, especially in the United States: in those cases the transfer takes place with the safeguards required by the GDPR, such as the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.

conservazione.testo: Requests and ideas, in anonymous form: {mesi} months. Codes used to limit requests: 48 hours.

cookie.testo: We only use one technical cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers the language you chose and is deleted when you close the browser. No tracking or third-party cookies. If you open a link to Amazon or Google Shopping, their privacy policies and cookies apply from that point.

affiliazione.testo: Some links to Amazon may be affiliate links: if you buy, {sito} may receive a small commission at no extra cost to you. Commissions don’t influence the ideas we suggest.

diritti.testo: You can ask for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability by writing to {email}. Since we don’t collect information that identifies you, we may not be able to find your requests: if you tell us the day, time and content, we’ll do our best. You can also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country (in Italy, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).

minori.testo: The service is not intended for people under 14.

extraUe.titolo: If you live outside the European Union
extraUe.testo: In the United Kingdom, the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 apply, with rights similar to those described here; the supervisory authority is the ICO. In the United States, some state laws (for example in California) grant rights of access and deletion: you can exercise them at the same address. We don’t sell personal data and we don’t share it for targeted advertising.

modifiche.testo: If we change this policy, we’ll say so on this page.

punti.1: Controller details and privacy contact (in src/config/sito.ts); if the controller is not in the EU, consider an EU/UK representative (Art. 27 GDPR).
punti.2: Data processing agreements (DPAs) with Anthropic, Supabase and Vercel; database region (EU recommended).
punti.3: Legal basis and legitimate-interest assessment for analysing requests; retention periods.
punti.4: Free-text fields: users might write sensitive data (health, religion) about a third party; assess Art. 9 GDPR and data minimisation.
punti.5: Minimum age and use by minors in the different countries.
punti.6: United Kingdom: UK GDPR, possible ICO registration. United States: state laws (CCPA/CPRA in California and others), any mandatory notices. Other non-EU countries: local regulations.
punti.7: Amazon Associates Program requirements for each marketplace (exact wording of the disclosure).

quiz.istruzioni: Swipe right for Yes, left for No.
